name: Oni
subtitle: Yokai Warrior
lore: These monstrous entities, demonic and ogrish, are among Izumo’s most widespread terrors. Able to crush grown men to a pulp or swallow them in a few quick bites, oni are the stuff of nightmares and fairy tales—and, unfortunately, an ever-growing number of genuine accounts. With the gods distracted by larger affairs, the oni grow ever bolder and more dangerous.

leader_bonus.text: Increases Attack by 20% in all game modes.

divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when damaging an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: Demonic Slash
skills.description: Deals 260%ATK damage to a single enemy. Has a 30% chance to apply [mechanic:bleed] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Warlord's Rage
skills.description: Gains [mechanic:atk-up-ii] for 2 turns. If Oni has [mechanic:bleed] on an enemy, he also gains an extra turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increases ATK Up II duration to 3 turns.

skills.name: Soul Rend
skills.description: Deals 400%ATK damage to a single enemy, ignoring 30% of their Defense. If the target is [mechanic:bleed]ing, this skill deals an additional 100%ATK damage.

skills.name: Demonic Presence
skills.description: Oni's attacks have a 20% chance to apply [mechanic:atk-down-i] for 1 turn. This chance is doubled if the target is [mechanic:bleed]ing.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increases ATK Down I chance to 30%.

skills.name: Flesh Feast
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (8%HP+110%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:drain-i] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Monstrous Pummel
skills.description: Attack (90%ATK+6%HP)4 times at random. Each hit has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:hex-i] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Yokai's Hex
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (10%HP+130%ATK). If the target is under [mechanic:hex], has a 35% chance to spread [mechanic:hex] to all enemies.
skills.awakening_bonus: This ability is still under review - please check back later.

skills.name: Mark of the Wicked
skills.description: [mechanic:reflect] 20% of damage inflicted on this hero to all enemies under [mechanic:hex].

imprint_passive: Reflect 10% of damage inflicted on this hero to all enemies under [Hex].
